kind_note: One append-only line per delegation in .factory/delegations.jsonl. `brief_sha256` binds the record to the exact brief handed to the executor: the pre-tool hook re-digests the file on disk, so an edited brief invalidates the delegation rather than silently authorizing a different one. `write` is DERIVED from stage state, never typed per request — three layers disagreed on the default and a read-only sandbox with approvalPolicy never can neither write nor ask.
